summary: NeoGenomics filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $275 million (plus $41.25 million greenshoe) 0.75% convertible senior notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A offering. The notes are senior unsecured, mature July 1, 2032, and are convertible under specified conditions. This is a debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The offering is expected to close June 22, 2026. No advisory or board recommendation is mentioned. Watch for dilution upon conversion; the low coupon suggests favorable terms. Risk-arb angle: minimal, as this is a standard convertible issuance.
